documents.title: Introduction
documents.assessment_note: Programming model: typed judgments consumed by code; no automatic model authoring.

documents.title: Quick start
documents.assessment_note: Request construction, environment key and direct SDK/API entry points.

documents.title: Jev with coding agents
documents.assessment_note: The skill teaches the coding agent an API; Jev does not replace that agent.

documents.title: Example use cases
documents.assessment_note: Use cases surveyed across industries; transfer patterns, not claimed domain accuracy.

documents.title: System One
documents.assessment_note: Fast bounded decisions; reserve multi-step invention for a generative model.

documents.title: State
documents.assessment_note: Send compact structured evidence, preserving observed versus inferred fields.

documents.title: Primitives (Questions)
documents.assessment_note: Three primitive families; batch independent questions on shared state.

documents.title: Choice
documents.assessment_note: Relative selection; include no-match and do not compare probabilities from different menus.

documents.title: Score
documents.assessment_note: Ordered self-contained levels; expected score is not a geometric measurement.

documents.title: Noul
documents.assessment_note: Yes probability, not degree or a separate confidence field.

documents.title: Advanced: structure
documents.assessment_note: Structured instructions and criteria can carry local candidate data.

documents.title: Confidence
documents.assessment_note: Retain probabilities; confidence is a derived statistic, not observed LDraw accuracy.

documents.title: How to build with TypeSafe
documents.assessment_note: Atomic questions, bounded decisions and explicit composition; candidate coverage first.

documents.title: AI primer
documents.assessment_note: Vendor explanation of calibration-oriented training; validate target-domain calibration.

documents.title: Patterns
documents.assessment_note: Pattern index read; individual linked pattern pages also read.

documents.title: Speculative fan-out
documents.assessment_note: Independent speculative questions share state; consume only applicable branches.

documents.title: Confidence-gated routing
documents.assessment_note: Escalation thresholds must be tuned to downstream losses and coverage.

documents.title: Composite scoring
documents.assessment_note: Weights in code can change without asking unchanged questions again.

documents.title: Intent routing
documents.assessment_note: Route to known handlers; the handler owns execution and deterministic rules.

documents.title: Cookbooks
documents.assessment_note: Cookbook index read; all 18 indexed cookbooks read, including code and outputs.

documents.title: Self-consistency: nouls
documents.assessment_note: Repeatability experiment is not accuracy; changing a unique state ID also changes input.

documents.title: Self-consistency: choices
documents.assessment_note: Gate increases agreement while reducing automatic coverage; repeated examples are not an LDraw benchmark.

documents.title: Parallel questions
documents.assessment_note: Long shared-state batching example; latency compares sequential calls, not an optimized concurrent baseline.

documents.title: Re-ranking
documents.assessment_note: 40 legal queries with BM25 shortlists; useful benchmark, not transferable LDraw effect size.

documents.title: Line-by-line search
documents.assessment_note: Presence Noul handles absent evidence even when a line Choice produces a confident winner.

documents.title: Structure recovery
documents.assessment_note: Recover structure then assemble in code; printed cost and prose disagree.

documents.title: Function calling
documents.assessment_note: Select functions and bounded arguments; consume relevant branches and handle absent values explicitly.

documents.title: Skill suggestion
documents.assessment_note: Shortlist and recheck; synthetic skill-routing evaluation does not establish assembly-selection accuracy.

documents.title: Knowledge graph entity alignment
documents.assessment_note: Semantic entity matching; do not infer physical interchangeability of parts from text.

documents.title: Classifying RAG passages
documents.assessment_note: Separate passage relevance, evidence and contradiction; filtering can lose useful evidence.

documents.title: Double-checking citations
documents.assessment_note: Exact quote checks in code before semantic entailment; small planted-error demonstration.

documents.title: Guardrails for LLMs
documents.assessment_note: Probability-based guardrails are fallible; broad moderation is not a current LDraw need.

documents.title: SDE cascade
documents.assessment_note: Generator/verifier/escalation pattern; no measured LDraw savings and no universal quality guarantee.

documents.title: Date extraction
documents.assessment_note: Extract bounded components, then perform calendar arithmetic in code; analogous to dimensions.

documents.title: Pre-parsed value extraction
documents.assessment_note: Code finds spans, Jev selects, code normalizes; missing candidates cannot be recovered.

documents.title: Hierarchical classification
documents.assessment_note: Four hierarchy examples; beam search is a ranking heuristic, not a calibrated leaf probability.

documents.title: Autoresearch feature discovery
documents.assessment_note: 2000 wine reviews; held-out improvement is real within that example, not evidence about visual model quality.

documents.title: Classification using confidence
documents.assessment_note: 60 filtered filings; broader labels improve a different, coarser outcome; threshold is domain-specific.

documents.title: Demos
documents.assessment_note: Demo index read.

documents.title: Smart home assistant demo
documents.assessment_note: Speculative fan-out and generative fallback; embedded video not transcribed or independently reviewed.

documents.title: Models

documents.title: API reference
documents.assessment_note: HTTP request/response shapes, option/level caps and error handling.

documents.title: Agent skill
